description: Defines logging categories and a static host class for managing loggers in the MigraDoc library, including categories for general, document model, PDF rendering, and RTF rendering logs.

classes.name: MigraDocLogCategory
classes.description: Contains constant string fields defining different logging categories for MigraDoc.

classes.name: MigraDocLogHost
classes.description: Provides static access to various loggers used within MigraDoc, managing logger creation and reset based on the global logging factory.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.MigraDocLogger
methods.description: Property that returns the global MigraDoc logger, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.DocumentModelLogger
methods.description: Property that returns the document object model logger.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.PdfRenderingLogger
methods.description: Property that returns the PDF rendering logger.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.RtfRenderingLogger
methods.description: Property that returns the RTF rendering logger.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.CheckFactoryHasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the logging factory has changed and resets loggers if needed.

methods.name: MigraDocLogHost.ResetLogging
methods.description: Resets all logger instances after a change in the global logging factory.
